table.name: TLGNC_ARCHIVING_LOG
table.description: Logtable used by the order archiving implementation.

column.name: ARCHIVING_LOG_ID
column.description: PK. Unique ID of the log entry.

column.name: ARCHIVING_LOG_EVENT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_archiving_log_event_bs. The event of the logged entry

column.name: DELETED_ENTRY_ID
column.description: Optional field, it contains the deleted entry id. The entry type must be decided by the eventtype

column.name: LOG_TEXT
column.description: Any text describing the logged event.
